Future Sensory receipt (not this candidate). Recorded so the member taxonomy is not lost.

A Sensory receipt is a different type from StructuralReductionReceipt. Members are stemmed sensory tokens, not SourceNodeRef. Coverage is term eligibility, not chart coverage. The reducer, if any, is a mean of observed distances (1 - hits/eligible), not Minimum.

Member taxonomy (the same lie as empty-terms-are-0.0, reproduced per token):

- HIT: stem is in node.lemmas → Observed(0.0)
- LOOKED UP AND MISSED: node.lemmas nonempty, stem not in the set → Observed(1.0)
- NEVER ELIGIBLE: node.lemmas empty (no inventory to look up in) → excluded/missing member, not a miss

Collapsing never-eligible into a miss repeats the term-level fabrication at member level.

This candidate does not build that receipt. It only lets empty sensoryTerms be recorded missing. Nonempty arithmetic stays 1 - hits/size, including the current 1.0 when lemmas are empty.
